title: Windows API string copy without a limit (c)
description: The code copies a string with lstrcpy, the Windows API copy that has no destination size. The destination is always a fixed buffer in practice, so a longer source overwrites adjacent memory.
remediation: Use the counted variant with an explicit destination size, for example the counted variant with a destination size.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the copy without checking the destination size.
